GET.functionality: Reads the scene_id from the url params, uses it to read and load the scene contents
GET.fallback: existing scene loading logic using ATON's scenehub parsing

PUT.functionality: Export changes for specified scene_id and replace existing content
PUT.fallback: Use ATON's existing scene API to update local scene

list_models.functionality: Retrieve list of available models as list
list_models.fallback: List model urls from aton's internal api

glb_model.functionality: Get the glb file of the corresponding model
glb_model.fallback: If model_list is an invalid endpoint then assume we fall back to reading from ATON's API. Then model name == model url

artefact_data.functionality: Given a model name, get the corresponding artefact details
artefact_data.fallback: No aton artefact details - return empty

schema.functionality: Get schema url from its name
schema.fallback: If list_schemas is invalid then assume we fall back to reading from res folder. Then schema name == schema url

metadata.functionality: Get the metadata of a specific object as an object

list_rgb_images.fallback: No rgb image endpoint in ATON - return empty

rgb_image.fallback: No rgb image endpoint in ATON - return null

list_multispectral_images.fallback: No multispectral images in ATON - return empty

multispectral_image.functionality: Get set of images for multispectral viewing
multispectral_image.fallback: No rgb image endpoint in ATON - return null

list_sensors.fallback: No equivalent ATON feature - return empty

sensor.functionality: Get final reading object of a sensor
